ui.tagline: Small steps. A garden full of possibilities.
ui.overviewIntro: Plan, observe and learn from every growing season.
ui.thisMonth: What you can do this month
ui.noWindows: No activity periods are recorded for this month.
ui.recommendation: Based on your activity periods. Check local soil, location and weather.
ui.emptyPlants: Your garden starts with a plant.
ui.emptyPlantsBody: Add your first plant and its activity periods. Keep your observations for years to come.
ui.emptyLocations: Give your plants a place to grow.
ui.noWeekWindows: No matching activity periods this week. Check the filters or your recorded periods.
ui.noSensors: No matching temperature sensors. You can also enter a sensor ID manually.
ui.noTasks: Nothing due right now. A moment to enjoy your garden.
ui.name: Name
ui.title: Title
ui.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Linked tasks or records may prevent deletion. Deleting a crop also removes its event timeline.
ui.snapshotHint: This snapshot stays unchanged when you edit the plant later.
ui.readOnly: You can view the shared garden. Editing shared data requires permission. You can complete your own personal tasks.
ui.disconnected: Garden Planner cannot be reached right now. Your open form is preserved.
ui.invalid_data: The details could not be saved. Check required fields, dates, temperature ranges and relationships.
ui.not_found: This record no longer exists. Refresh the view.
ui.conflict: Data has changed or still has linked records. Refresh and review before trying again.
ui.storage_error: Data could not be processed. Check storage and backups.
ui.unauthorized: You do not have permission for this action.
ui.not_loaded: Garden Planner is not loaded yet.
ui.unexpected: This action could not be completed. Please try again.
ui.languageHint: This browser only. Without a selection, the Home Assistant language is used.
ui.dataSafetyBody: Export your garden story or create a local backup. Replacement imports always require a reviewed preview.
ui.replaceWarning: The entire dataset will be replaced by the reviewed file. A backup is created first.
ui.confirmReplace: I want to replace the dataset.
ui.invalidFile: The file is invalid, incomplete or too large (maximum 20 MiB).
ui.adminOnly: Import and backups require an administrator.
ui.notificationsHint: Reminders are not available yet. No notifications are sent.
ui.observationHint: Results are your documented observations, not automatically inferred causes.
ui.temperatureHint: Germination ranges refer to the substrate. Air measurements are not automatically comparable.
ui.initialEventHint: Edit the initial event date and status through its sowing record.
ui.limitedTransport: File transfers are also subject to your Home Assistant connection size limit.
ui.yearlyHint: Each row shows an activity. Tap a bar for period details and the plant profile.
ui.numberRange: Check numeric ranges and valid calendar dates.

host.postponeHint: Choose a new due date. The task stays open and existing reminder destinations use its new date. Moving beyond the series end stops repetition.
host.repeatHint: Leave the interval blank for a one-off task. Completing creates exactly one follow-up in a fixed day rhythm from the previous due date. Overdue dates are not skipped automatically. Personal plant reminders keep their annual plan.
host.cultureWeatherHint: Weather hints apply only to active, explicitly outdoor and frost-sensitive cultivations.
host.weatherUnavailable: No usable current forecast is available. This does not mean frost-free conditions.
host.weatherForecastHint: Forecast from the selected HA weather integration, not a bed measurement. Display only; no automatic notifications.
host.frostAffected: Below the warning threshold: check and protect these sensitive outdoor cultivations as appropriate.
host.noFrostHint: No current hint for the marked cultivations. Always check conditions on site.
host.weatherSettingsHint: Optionally select an existing HA weather entity. Hints appear in overview and garden mode. Mark the cultivation as frost sensitive and actually outdoors; planned, completed and failed cultivations are excluded.
host.harvestUnitsHint: Weights and pieces are separate. — means the plant count is unknown.
host.moreHarvestFilters: Filter by plant, variety and bed
host.photoLoadError: The photo could not be loaded.
host.seedLotHint: A lot can represent one packet. Units are summed separately. Germination is recorded from your input, never estimated. Shopping status remains independent.
host.useOlderStock: Sorted by stated best-before date, then purchase year. Use opened and older lots first.
host.seedPastDate: The stated date has passed. Consider a germination test; the date alone does not mean no seeds will germinate.
host.noSeedLots: No seed lots recorded for this plant.
host.plantCountHint: Enter the actual plant count used for yield in the cultivation. Sowing quantity is not used automatically. Unknown counts leave per-plant yield blank.
host.journalHint: This entry belongs to the selected cultivation and does not change its lifecycle status automatically. Individual harvests contribute to the total. One photo per entry; add further photos as separate entries.
host.harvestAnalysisHint: Grams and kilograms are combined as kilograms; piece counts stay separate. Plant, variety and location are captured when recording the harvest. Per-plant results use the current plant count for each contributing cultivation once per unit and group. Any unknown count leaves that average blank. Years refer to the harvest date.
host.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 12 MiB. Saved locally as a small PNG preview; the original file and metadata are not retained.
host.imageInvalid: The image could not be processed. Choose a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 12 MiB.
host.matrixFilter: Filter plants in rows and columns
host.matrixHint: Click a cell: unassigned → good → unfavorable → unassigned. Changes apply reciprocally. Add external names using “Edit neighbors”.
host.substrateHint: Green indicates the optimal germination substrate temperature.
host.seedSaveFailed: Your choices have not been confirmed as saved. Retry or discard and reload.
host.neighborIntro: Record your own companion-planting observations. Catalog links automatically apply to both plants.
host.extraGoodNeighbors: Other good neighbors (one name per line)
host.extraBadNeighbors: Other bad neighbors (one name per line)
host.neighborConflict: Assign each neighbor to only one group and do not select the plant itself. For duplicate plant names, use catalog selection.
host.seedIntro: Shared seed planning for your plant catalog. Select one state per plant. Choices save automatically; wait for saving to finish before closing.
host.seedHint: Use “Not needed” for trees, shrubs or a seasonal break. “Undecided” means no choice yet. If another edit conflicts, discard choices and select again.
host.completeTaskBody: Mark this task as complete? It will be removed from Upcoming garden work.
host.personalSubtitle: Choose what you want to be reminded about.
host.personalUnavailable: Personal reminders are available in the Home Assistant integration.
host.personalIntro: Your personal task plan. Selected activity periods create tasks under Upcoming garden work. Your choices save automatically.
host.personalGlobalOff: Reminder delivery is globally disabled. Tasks are still generated; an administrator must enable notification delivery.
host.personalChannelOff: No personal delivery destination is enabled for you. Ask an administrator to configure push or email.
host.personalNoWindow: No activity period exists for this activity.
host.personalHint: Available activities start enabled. Missing windows disable the checkbox. Newly available activities start enabled. Opting out removes related open tasks; completed history is preserved. Tasks cover the next twelve months and can be completed. Push/email use the existing settings. Saving sends no test message.
host.personalSharedHint: A shared channel is also enabled. It continues to notify shared manual tasks. Personal generated tasks go only to your personal delivery destinations.
host.multiFilterHint: Select multiple values. An empty selection shows all.
host.sharedChannelEnabled: Send to existing shared channel (may include additional recipients)
host.sidebarHint: Revoking viewing hides the native HA sidebar link and keeps other entries unchanged. Administrators retain access. Already-open views lose data access; older clients may need a reload.
host.rolesHint: Administrators always have full access. Editing includes viewing. These permissions protect the Garden Planner panel and its data API; native HA entities also follow Home Assistant permissions.
host.routeHint: Enable push and email independently for each user. Select the actual device or email entity; Home Assistant does not automatically assign destinations to users. No test messages are sent. Identical destinations receive at most one attempt per date.
host.reminderInfo: Only stored windows and tasks are considered. No care dates are guessed. At most one delivery attempt is made per date; an uncertain failed attempt is not automatically repeated.
host.reminderCatchup: After downtime, dates up to seven days in the past are considered. Enabling reminders may include such dates that have not been attempted yet.
host.outsideRange: The germination substrate temperature is outside the recorded optimal germination range.
host.notComparable: This measurement is not a direct germination-substrate reading. No automatic germination comparison is made.
host.grantedEditor: You have permission to edit this shared garden.
host.notifyEntityHint: A notification entity is an existing HA identifier such as notify.mail_martin, not an email address. Select it for notify.send_message; configure SMTP recipient entities in Home Assistant. Leave this field empty for legacy services such as notify.email. Use the user table with an explicit recipient address for separate legacy email recipients. Enabling a user destination switches off the existing shared channel. It sends additionally to its configured defaults only if explicitly switched back on.

bed.placeHelp: Tap a position or drag the highlighted group. Then save directly here on the bed.
bed.periodHint: From direct sowing / transplanting to the end of harvest. Review suggestions; stored or manually edited dates are never overwritten automatically.
bed.periodMissing: No unambiguous period available. Set start and end yourself; the year overview can help.
bed.periodAmbiguous: Several crop sequences are possible. Choose a suggestion or enter your own dates.
bed.unknownNeighbors: No assessed relationship within range. Unknown does not mean compatible.
bed.neighborLegend: Green: good · Red: unfavorable · Gray: unknown
bed.invalidPeriod: Check the plant, valid dates, counts and row layout.
bed.noPlantPeriods: No activity periods have been recorded for this plant.
bed.freehandStep: Hold the mouse button or use your finger to draw the desired outline.
bed.outlineStep: Tap the desired corners on the canvas one after another (at least three).
bed.holeStep: Tap the cut-out corners inside the bed one after another (at least three).
bed.applyStep: Then click “Apply drawing”. This exits drawing mode so you can drag the white corner handles again.
bed.saveDrawingStep: Finally use “Save bed shape” to store the change permanently.
bed.cancelDrawingHint: Use “Cancel drawing” or Escape to return to the previous shape without applying the drawing.
bed.drawingApplied: Drawing applied. Please use “Save bed shape” to store it permanently.
bed.unsavedShape: The changed bed shape has not been saved yet.
bed.confirmLayout: Really delete this empty bed layout?
bed.newBed: First add a location under Beds & locations.
bed.drawHint: After drawing, click “Apply drawing” to return to the white corner handles, then “Save bed shape”. Use “Cancel drawing” to return without applying.
bed.moveHint: Tap plants to select them. Drag to move, or edit metric coordinates. Confirm with Save occupancy.
bed.empty: No occupancy for this season yet.
bed.outside: Plants lie outside the usable bed.
bed.rotation: Check rotation: same plant family within resting interval
bed.hintHelp: Hints use your own records and are planning aids, not agronomic guarantees. Unknown neighbors are not treated as good. Rotation applies to the whole bed; spatial spacing is checked only for simultaneous occupancy.
bed.seedHelp: Plant requirements and seed counts differ. Grams/packets are not converted; germination, losses and other reservations are not deducted automatically. Shopping choices are not changed automatically.
bed.readOnly: Read only – garden editing permission is required.
bed.error: Unable to save. Check geometry, coordinates, dates and relationships.
bed.historyUnknown: Historical cultivations without a plant family cannot be checked reliably.
bed.noWarnings: No conflicts detected from the available information.
bed.shortHelp: Shapes and positions use real centimeters; zoom changes the view only. Every occupancy has its own date range and is preserved over years.
